abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: The Summoned Symbiote's enhanced evolutionary state prevents him from being awakened beyond his current state.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: 40% chance to inflict Bleed Debuff dealing [1,195] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Symbiotic Evolution - Pre-Fight Ability
content: The Summoned Symbiote can gain Persistent Charges by entering quests that offer them via quest nodes only.

Persistent Charges are used to activate Evolution Abilities in the Pre-Fight screen, once activated these abilities remain active for the rest of the quest. Each Evolution grants +[239] Attack Rating and can stack up to 3 times.
Devour: Costs 1 Persistent Charge.
Infect: Costs 1 Persistent Charge.
Adapt: Costs 1 Persistent Charge.
Leach: Costs 3 Persistent Charges.
Enrage: Costs 3 Persistent Charges.
Annihilate: Costs 5 Persistent Charges.

abilitySections.title: Evolutions
content: Devour: Reduce the Opponents Nullify and Stagger Ability Accuracy by 35% and Light Attacks have a 30% chance to Nullify 1 Buff. Each time this Nullify occurs, Passively Regenerate +[470.76] Base Health.

Infect: Medium Attacks reduce Evade Ability Accuracy by a flat 50%. Additionally, Heavy Attacks have a 60% chance to remove a Bleed Debuff from the Opponent and replace it with a Poison Debuff, dealing 6692 Direct Damage, reducing Health Recovery by 30% and reducing Evade Ability Accuracy by 50% for 16 seconds.

Adapt: If the last hit landed was a Medium Attack, landing another Medium Attack grants a Fury Buff for 9 seconds, increasing Attack Rating by +191.2 and bypassing 10% of the Opponent's Physical and Energy Resistance.

Leech: For 10 seconds after throwing a Special Attack, each time the Summoned Symbiote dashes backward, Purify 4 Debuffs and Steal 10% of the Opponent's current Power, gaining 45% of the Power stolen.
Enrage: Reduce the Opponent's Purify Ability Accuracy by 70% and start the fight with a Fortitude Buff, reducing incoming damage from all sources by 18%.

Annihilate: Increase the potency, chance and duration of all Evolutions except this one by 20%. When struck, there is a 20% chance to gain an Unstoppable Buff for 2 seconds. The first hit of all Special Attacks inflicts a Shrivel Debuff, reducing the Opponent's Combat Power Rate and Ability Power Rate by 15% for 12 seconds and the last hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for 1.2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Gain 1 of the following Buffs at random for 18 seconds.
True Damage: allowing Attacks to bypass Armor and Resistance.
Armor Up: increasing Armor Rating by +[3,150].
Fury: increasing Attack Rating by [2,151].

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit inflicts an Armor Break Debuff for 20 seconds, reducing Armor Rating by [3,900] and removing 1 Armor Up Buff.
